name: Rain
author: David JM
description: Background effects over the desktop wallpaper, behind your windows. Toggled from the bar: a GPU shader paints animated rain or a crackling fireplace on a full-screen background layer, with optional lightning.

barWidget.description: A wand icon that paints effects over the desktop wallpaper. Pick Rain (falling streaks, optional lightning bolts) or Fireplace (a crackling hearth with rising embers). Effects render on a background layer behind every window, so your apps stay on top. Click to toggle; right-click for the effect switch, continuous intensity and speed sliders, and lighting options.

schema.label: Effect
schema.description: Rain over the wallpaper, or a crackling fireplace hearth with rising embers.

schema.label: Rain density
schema.description: Rain intensity (1 = drizzle to 3 = downpour) or fireplace size (1 = small to 3 = large), continuous. Values are non-integer in practice (the widget's slider writes e.g. 2.4); the schema type is limited to integer for the editor.

schema.label: Lightning flashes
schema.description: Rain-only. Random real lightning bolts (with a soft sky flash) drawn by the shader.
